sections.text: Full-time employees accrue 18 days of PTO per calendar year, accrued monthly at a rate of 1.5 days per month. PTO accrual begins on an employee's start date. Employees may carry over a maximum of 5 unused PTO days into the following calendar year; any balance above 5 days is forfeited on December 31st unless local law requires otherwise. PTO requests must be submitted in the HR system at least 5 business days in advance for any absence longer than 2 consecutive days. Requests of 1-2 days may be submitted with 24 hours notice, subject to manager approval based on team coverage needs.

Employees receive 10 paid sick days per calendar year, separate from PTO. Sick leave does not carry over year to year and does not need advance notice, but employees should notify their manager before their normal start time on the day of absence. For absences of 3 or more consecutive sick days, a doctor's note may be requested by HR.

Employees are entitled to 5 paid bereavement days for the death of an immediate family member (spouse, child, parent, sibling) and 2 paid days for extended family. These days do not count against PTO.

result.rule: The company-wide 18 days of PTO apply, but forfeiture is prohibited: the company-wide rule that forfeits unused PTO above 5 days on December 31 does not apply in California. All unused PTO carries over, subject to an accrual cap of 27 days (1.5x the annual entitlement).
